long_biography.plain_text:
Work in the private department of his father, UAE founder Sheikh Zayed, preceded Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan's appointments to national security leadership. He became the UAE's national security adviser before his appointment as Deputy Ruler of Abu Dhabi. He also chairs Royal Group and International Holding Company, whose activities range from finance and real estate to technology and healthcare.

While studying in California, Sheikh Tahnoon took up jiu-jitsu and returned determined to develop the sport in the UAE. He founded the Abu Dhabi Combat Club and helped establish a national training culture around the discipline. Chess provided another sustained interest: he supported the Hydra supercomputer project and has served as honorary president of the Abu Dhabi Chess and Culture Club.
